model_assumptions: candidate cadence K is positive and discrete
peak/ephemeral demand is nondecreasing in K before capacity clamp
pressure indicator is nondecreasing in K

compiler.step_1: group cadences by identical intervention count N(K)
compiler.step_2: keep the smallest K in each intervention class as the frontier representative
compiler.step_3: retain larger same-class K values as mechanism-only cadences
compiler.step_5: at capacity H, frontier is all activated representatives plus the minimum-intervention fallback representative

b447_compilation.note: 96 is the minimum-intervention fallback and remains on the frontier even before its pressure-free threshold
